protocol.note: packed weights with an unfused dequantise-then-multiply path; no fused kernel

limits: Teaching-grade packing: weights are stored at half a byte (INT4) or a quarter byte (ternary) per value, but the dequantise is a Python/chunked torch path, not a fused kernel, so the speed column is a lower bound on this machine, not on the format.

Peak and settled RSS do not fall when the weights are packed: packing happens after the float32 checkpoint is loaded in the same process, and the allocator keeps those pages. The payload column is what the format stores; `packed_footprint.json` measures the deployment-side number by streaming the checkpoint instead.
Only nn.Linear layers outside lm_head are packed; embeddings and norms stay float32.
One CPU, torch 2.6.0, float32, 128-token prompt, 32 greedy tokens.
